items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Every caption -- sex-crazed negro, sex-drugged crazed negro attacks detective, Samuel Green, age seven, alleged to have stolen a couple of bananas.

ctx.x: He's sensitive in ear and he's sensitive of many things and he's hearing all of these racial things and he knows that that's what's happening. Everyday.
Every caption -- sex-crazed negro, sex-drugged crazed negro attacks detective, Samuel Green, age seven, alleged to have stolen a couple of bananas. That's the caption, and you see that.
Now, all these things -- but you don't have that. In your mind -- why do I feel so good? Because you don't have that. You are not on guard all the time, so you feel relaxed. Do you understand?
